s: Today we are talking about feelings.
Every person feels nervous, surprised, worried, lonely, or grateful sometimes.
These are normal feelings, and they are our five words today.
When was the last time you were nervous, Maya?
I was nervous before my first day at work.
I felt nervous because everything was new.
I did not know the people or the office.
Being nervous is normal when something is new.
Did you feel nervous for a long time?
After one hour, I stopped feeling nervous.
So I was only nervous for a short time.
Many people feel nervous before a test or a trip.
Feeling nervous does not mean you are weak.

Last week my friends gave me a surprise birthday party.
I was so surprised when I opened the door.
I felt surprised and happy at the same time.
I was surprised last month when my brother visited me.
He did not tell me he was coming.
I opened the door and saw him, and I was surprised and very happy.
Being surprised is a strong feeling.
Sometimes we are surprised by good news, and sometimes we are surprised by bad news.
My friend was surprised when her boss gave her a new job.
She was surprised because she did not expect it.
But she was happy, not worried.
Worried is another feeling we all know.
I am worried about my exam next week.
I study every day, but I still feel worried.
Being worried keeps me awake at night.
I was worried about my flight last year.
The weather was bad, and I felt worried the whole day.
When you feel worried, it helps to talk to a friend.
My friend told me, do not be worried, you studied hard.
Sometimes we feel worried about small things, and sometimes we feel worried about big things.
It means you are alone and you do not like it.
When I moved to a new city, I felt lonely.
In the evenings, I felt lonely in my small apartment.
How did you stop feeling lonely?
I met new people there, and I stopped feeling lonely.
Now I have many friends, and I never feel lonely.
Being lonely does not last forever.
If you feel lonely, try to meet new people or call an old friend.

Our last word today is grateful.
Grateful means you feel thankful for something good.
I am grateful for my friends' help.
Last week they helped me move to a new home.
I felt so grateful when I saw all the boxes in the right rooms.
I am grateful for my family.
They call me every week, and I feel grateful for their love.
Being grateful is a happy feeling.
When you feel grateful, you smile more.
I try to think of three things I am grateful for every night.
Today I am grateful for this podcast, for our listeners, and for a sunny day.
Let us review our five words.
Nervous, surprised, worried, lonely, and grateful.
Do not be afraid of your feelings.
Talk about them, and they become easier.
Thank you for listening to Muse English today.
